acceptanceCriteria: The first indexed call on an over-bound corpus refuses in under 50 ms at the #1254 shape (~100k records), naming the bound and a count or lower bound.
body: V1-1995 (PR #1264, DCP-V1-193..197) memoizes the query index or its refusal per opened artifact, so later calls answer in under 50 ms, but the first index-backed call still derives the whole index before refusing. #1254 asked the refusal to arrive in under 50 ms. A cheap lower bound on postings/key bytes computed before term extraction could refuse earlier.

completion.reason: Evaluated won't-do: a first-call refusal under 50 ms is infeasible until evidence-term extraction is cheaper. Evidence is the SHA-256 of docs/build-log/2026-10-19-V1-2000-corpus-early-refusal.md at main c27d54e9 (PR #1266 via batch #1268); #1254 closed as delivered by #1264 (batch #1265); speed-up tracked in V1-2001.

title: Indexed corpus tools still pay one full index derivation (~0.5 s) before the first over-bound refusal (GitHub #1254 residual)
